error.message: getWorkItem failed: HTTP 401 — Jira rejected the credentials (GET /myself → 401), so it answered anonymously with a 404 — check that JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN in .env belong to the same Atlassian account and that the token is not revoked (https://example.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issue/PROJ-404?expand=renderedFields%2Cnames)
